title: Scripture and False Teaching
definition: Scripture and False Teaching means God’s Word exposes error and protects believers from teaching that leads away from Christ and the Gospel.
summary: Scripture and False Teaching means God’s Word exposes error and protects believers from teaching that leads away from Christ and the Gospel.
christFocus: Jesus warned against false teachers and gives His people truth in Scripture so they may remain faithful to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
False teaching is dangerous because it can sound spiritual while leading people away from truth. It may deny Christ, distort grace, excuse sin, promote fear, promise secret knowledge, or place human authority above Scripture.

Scripture protects believers by giving a clear standard. The Church is called to test teaching, guard the Gospel, recognize fruit, and hold fast to the apostolic witness of Christ.

The goal is not suspicion for its own sake. The goal is faithfulness to Jesus and love for people who could be harmed by deception. Truth protects the vulnerable and keeps the Church centered on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People who have been church hurt may know the damage false teaching can cause. Scripture gives a way to discern without becoming bitter, fearful, or spiritually isolated.

This doctrine also corrects the idea that love avoids correction. Biblical love protects people from teaching that enslaves, deceives, or draws them away from the Savior.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test teaching by Scripture, especially what it says about Christ, the Gospel, sin, grace, holiness, and authority. Refuse fear-based speculation and spiritual manipulation, and seek teachers who handle God’s Word with humility, clarity, and love.
